main_results.scope: Uniform relative-error estimation for finite irreducible aperiodic chains from an arbitrary initial law, using gammaHat, 0 < ε < 1/2, 0 < δ < 1 and the sample bound with C ≥ 73728.
Minimax bounds for the exact source model class with d ≥ 2, 0 < p ≤ 1/d, 0 < g ≤ 1/8 and 0 < ε < 1/2, using constants 1/2048 and 73729; the known-stationary reversible lower bound is included.
Gap-of-powers bounds for every positive integer k and the source stationary vector, together with the associated contraction consequence.
Concentration of the actual empirical relative Laplacian with the source probability bound and constants, without an external concentration premise.
Both Appendix visit-count bounds for arbitrary initial distributions and the explicitly defined blocking parameter.
Paulin concentration and scalar/matrix Freedman yield the concentration properties used by the principal upper bounds.
